segments.text: Could a nuclear reactor power Singapore one day?
Inside a nuclear reactor, tiny atoms split and release a lot of heat, without making carbon dioxide. Small modular reactors are newer, smaller designs.
Singapore is studying them, but has not decided yet. On a small, crowded island, scientists must first be sure they are safe.
So, which would you choose: more solar, power from our neighbours, or nuclear? Watch the full episode on Science Around Us.
